name: localdev-electron
description: An AI-Integrated IDE that runs locally.

scripts.start:dev: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); const electron = require('electron'); cp.spawn('bash', ['-c', './backend.sh &'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); cp.spawn('bash', ['-c', 'cd frontend && npm i && npm run dev:client &'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); cp.spawn(electron, ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && cp -r frontend/dist/. dist/ && cp -r electron dist/electron && node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); delete pkg.build; delete pkg.scripts; delete pkg.devDependencies; require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));" && electron-builder
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
